Thursday, 17th September, 2026
Welcome to our school
Headteacher's statement
"Pupils are happy and proud to belong to this welcoming school. The school is inclusive and the heart of the local community. The values of love, hope and courage run through the school. Pupils talk enthusiastically about why these are important and the ways they can demonstrate them.", Ofsted, July 2025.
A very warm welcome to Arreton St George's Church of England Primary School. We are delighted that you are interested in our school and hope you will visit us soon to experience our friendly, caring atmosphere for yourself.
Our school values - Love, Hope and Courage - are at the heart of everything we do. They guide the spiritual, moral, social, cultural and academic development of every pupil, helping each child to grow and achieve their very best.
We are passionate about creating a school environment that nurtures a love of learning. Our locally inspired curriculum is designed to spark curiosity and inspire a lifelong passion for discovery.
Nestled in the beautiful Arreton Valley, right in the centre of the Isle of Wight, our small village school benefits from stunning rural surroundings. With direct access to local downlands and farmland - without needing to cross any roads - we make the most of our location to enhance outdoor learning whenever possible.
It is a privilege to be part of every child's educational journey. Our strong Christian ethos ensures that together we help children grow into caring, confident and unique individuals - spiritually, emotionally and academically.
We invite you to explore our website to discover more about life at Arreton St George's. If you would like to arrange a visit, we would be delighted to welcome you.
Mrs Nicky Coates (Headteacher)

All about us
About our school
At Arreton St George's Primary school we pride ourselves on our warm friendly family environment where all children feel valued, safe and secure. Our curriculum reflects our belief that learning is fun and accessible to all. We have worked hard to establish a curriculum that is broad, balanced and allows children to make progress with their skills and knowledge in all areas.
We are committed and passionate about delivering an education that is inspiring, fun, thought provoking, relevant and accessible to all our children. Our school values of Love, Hope and Courage form an integral part of our ethos and underpin our pledge to develop the whole child and equip them with the life skills they need.
It is a privilege to be part of every child's education, our Christian ethos, vision and values ensure that together we can help our children grow up to be caring, unique individuals, spiritually, emotionally and academically. Please take a look around the website to see what we can offer you and your child. If you would like to come and visit please contact the office on 01983 528429 to book a tour. Every day is an open day.
Mrs Nicky Coates Headteacher
Wilbur, School Dog (in training!)
Who are School Governors?
School governors are unpaid volunteers who hold headteachers to account and ensure that schools are meeting their strategic objectives.
What are their key responsibilities?
How are they chosen?
There are various categories of Governors:
Associate Members are appointed to one or more committees of the board because they have specific knowledge and expertise in a particular area. Associate Members are not Governors.
If you wish to contact the governing board, then please contact the clerk to the board at clerk@arretoncepri.iow.sch.uk.
Parent Governors are elected by parents
Staff Governors are elected by staff

Visions & Values
Building on our values of Love, Hope and Courage we nurture resilient hearts and inspire minds filled with compassion and a hopeful spirit. This vision is theologically rooted in the Parable of the Mustard Seed - Matthew 13:31-32. During Collective Worship the children learn that the seed represents the hidden or small start of faith, the tree represents the stable, blessed life of the believer and the result is Life, shelter, Inclusion and fruit for others to see.
Through Collective Worship, hearing Bible stories, by example and behaviour, our children learn that our core values give richness and purpose to their own lives, and are the basis of our school as a Christian community.
Children at Arreton feel inspired, supported and celebrated. Through our core Christian values of Love, Hope and Courage, we aim to create an environment where every child is nurtured, respected and empowered to make a positive difference to themselves and others. Our values are integral to all our daily lives, how we teach and what our children learn. Within the context of a broad, inclusive framework, we are working together to develop a school where individuals can excel and flourish academically, socially and emotionally preparing them for life's journey.
Each person is uniquely valued for all of their gifts and potential, which we nurture and further develop. Every member of the school accepts the responsibility of caring for one another and for the wonderful world we have been given.
Through Collective Worship, hearing Bible stories, by example and behaviour, our children learn that our core values give richness and purpose to their own lives, and are the basis of our school as a Christian community.
As a community the bible stories chosen to represent are school values are:
The ethos of our school was best captured by one of our children who said, "We are all different and that's fine, we all get along and accept people for who they are."
Love - The Good Samaritan.
Hope - Noah's Ark.
Courage - David and Goliath.
